store.0: I'm a fourth-year computer science major and I find that my hobbies help me stay sane amidst a hectic schedule. I love coding, but I also enjoy other activities that give me a fresh perspective when I return to programming.
store.1: I have a passion for sailing. It's a hobby that brings me a sense of freedom and challenges me in a unique way. I enjoy the unpredictability of the wind and the water, and it satisfies my problem-solving side. It's a great way to clear my mind and take a break from the stresses of college life.
store.2: I'm a fourth-year Computer Science student and I've seen how the campus culture has evolved over the years. I've discovered various communities that make this place feel like a second home. There are many ways to get involved beyond just coding.
store.3: I joined the Computer Science Society, which hosts weekly meetups to discuss new technologies, share personal projects, and have industry speakers. It's a welcoming environment, even for beginners. I can often get help from fellow members who have worked on similar topics in their internships.
